pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

head_sleep.desc: asleep: eyes closed, peaceful; pivot at the neck (0, 8.6)

head_wake.desc: waking: heavy, half-open eyes; pivot at the neck (0, 8.6)

head.desc: awake: a gentle look (reddish-brown eyes); pivot at the neck (0, 8.6)

head_smile.desc: smiling, eyes closed happily; pivot at the neck (0, 8.6)

body_seated.desc: seated cross-legged: white robe with gold Luff-glyph trim, bare feet, the red-berry clasp at the collar; the root card, pivot (0, 0.5) on the dais

arm_front.desc: the front arm resting on the lap; pivot at the shoulder

arm_back.desc: the back arm, a tone darker; pivot at the shoulder

arm_reach.desc: the hand-over: the front arm held out, palm up (the piece sits on it); pivot at the shoulder

compass_piece.desc: the compass piece he guarded: a curved golden plate with a pale-blue jewel; held on arm_reach's palm, at about (-7.6, 7.2)
